prompt: Side-on wide shot at night of a giant steel crane leg planting its foot down onto a concrete motorway flyover full of abandoned cars: the deck cracking, a ring of dust and debris blasting out sideways, car alarms flashing, the leg rising out of frame. Lit by burning cars and the flyover's last working lamps. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
